translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús gwalulesad
Amba yo Jesús gwaluleged-idu, deun Augusto-César saila-dummadga Romagi maigu, igar mesialid, bela-dulemar-bukwad-ebisoye, igi mergu-dibeye.
We gebe dule-ebisleged imaklesdo, deun Cirenio dummadga Siria-yargi neg-dakmaiun.
Bela ebislemalagala na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburse nade-gusmalad.
José, Galilea-yargi, Nazaret-neggweburgi gudiid ali-gusmogad, Judea-yarse, Rey-David-neggweburse, Belén neg-nugadse, ade José, David-e-wagwad, aga Belénse nonisundo,
adi a-neggweburgi e-ome-Maríamala ebislemalagar. Deun bato igar-maid ebo nikuoye, degine, deun María bato gurgin-nika gudiid.
Belén-neggweburgi gudimala, María-ibagan warmaknonikid, goe-baked-iba.
Degine, machigwa gebe ega uklenonikid, agi samorgi obirmas, degi, moli-omaed-urgi mimmi-mesisad, ar ade emarga gabed-neg sate gusad.
Angermar sognonikid, Jesús gwalulesye
Deun a-ibagi Belén-neggwebur-dikarba, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad, e-sibad-wawaad mutik edarbebukwa-gusmalad.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-e-anger-wargwen amarse ukiar nonikid, degine, Bab-Dummad-e-yeer-dakleged-gaed bela emar-ebilis ibegwar ganonikid. Degine, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad gwakiarmalad.
Ar angerdi amarga sogded: —Mer be dobgumar, ar bemarga gaya-burba-nued, bela dulemar-weligwar-saed an sedanikid.
Rey-David-gwalulesad-neggweburgi, Beléngi, emi-ibagi bemarga Cristo gwalulesad, dule-Abonoged, Dule-Dummad, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule.
Weyob be wilubdakmaloed: Mimmi samorgi-anwar moli-omaed-urgi mai be dakmaloed.
Degine ukiar, we-anger-abargi bukidar-angermar-nibnegginmalad-baigan daklealid, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannonanai, sognanai:
Degine, nibnegse gannar angermar nadmarbargu, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad na ga sokarmalad: —Ar anmar Belén-neggweburse namarsun, degi-neg-gusad daknamarsun, Bab Dummad anmar-owisosadba.
Sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad gwae-gwae armarsunnad. Daknonimalad, José, María, degi, mimmi, moli-omaed-urgi mai.
Degi-dakarmargu, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad sogdemalad, igi angermar mimmigi ega sunmaksamala.
Ar bela-dulemar sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad ibmar sogsa itosmalad, geger itomalad we-ibmar sogmalad.
Ar Maríadi bela na e-gwagegi wargwen sedii-gusad, agi binsadii-gusad.
Ar sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad, ega ibmar soglesadba bela gusad daksamalad, degi, bela itosmalad-ular, gannar armargu, Bab-Dummad-nug odummodani, degi, ogannodani-gusmalad.
Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse seleapid
Jesús ibabaabakgus gwalulesadgi, Judiomar-igar-maidba imakegala, e-abgan-duku siksamalad, ega nug Jesúsye uksamalad, ar igi anger amba yo María bonigwar-gued-idu bato nug imaksadba.
Moisés-igar-mesisadba imakegala, María goe-nikusad-sorba ibagan nonisun, na san nudakmalagar. A-ular José, María-ebo, Jerusalénse Jesús-senonimalad, Bab Dummadga ukegar.
Ar igi Bab-Dummad-igargi narmakar mai:
Degine, ar igi Bab-Dummad-igargi narmakar naibali, Bab Dummadga ukoye:
Lv. 12:6-8 We sognaidba imakegala, María nonimogad.

A-ibagangine, Jerusaléngi, dule-wargwen, Simeón-nugad, gudigusad. A-dulede dule-gwage-nuedid, Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadiid, na Israel-bendakleged-edarbedimogad-duled. Bab Dummad Burba Nued a-duleba gudiguad.
Bab Dummad na E-Burba-Nuedba Simeónga sogsad: “Be burgosurye, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-dakedseye.”
Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse Jesús-e-babgan na mimmi-senonimargu, Moisés-igar-maidba imakegala, deun Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-sogedba, Simeón Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nonimogad.
Simeón na e-swidawargi machigwa-mesisgua, Bab-Dummad-nug odummoded, sogded:

content.text: ar iduar be ibmar anga sogsadyob.

content: José, degi Jesús-e-nan, María, geger itomalad, Simeón bela weyob Jesúsgi sognaid.

Geb degi Simeón, Jesúsga sogsagu, Bab Dummad begi nued binsaoye, a-sorba machigwa-e-nanga, Maríaga sogded: —We-machigwa sulesad Israel-yargi dulemar-dummagan-bukidar onogegar, degi, dulemar-binsarmalad dummaganga imakegar. We-machigwa Bab-Dummad-wilubga guega nonikid, oyogegar, Bab Dummad sunna nabir dulemar-abonoye. Ar degi-inigwele, dulemar-bukidar machigwa-abingaosurmalad.
We-machiba bukidar-dulemar-gwage-binsananaid mag daklegoed. María, ar begardi be-san-burbagi espunyar-yolenaiyob be nunmak itogoed.

Agine Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged-wargwen, Ana-nugad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudimogad. A-omede, Fanuel-sisgwad, Aser-e-wagwasik danikid. Anade bato nue seredgusad, unnila birga-gugle sui-nika gudigusad,

degine birga-dulabake-gakabakegus ei-sui-burgwisad. A-mukwade Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudigu-daed, ibginedba, degi, mutikidba Bab Dummadse gordii, degi, mas-gunsuli, Bab-Dummadse-golega-gudii-daed-duled.
Simeón deyob sunmakgwichidgi, Ana nonimogad. A-mukwa Bab Dummadga Jesúsgi dog-nuedye sogsa-gusad, degi, bela Jerusaléngi dulemar-Bab-Dummad-abonogoed-edarbedimaladga machi-bipigi ega sunmakde-daed.
Jesús gannar Nazaretse nonikid
José, María-ebo bela Bab-Dummad-igar-maidba ibmar-imaksad-sorba, gannar Galilease nonimalad, na e-neggwebur-Nazaretse.
Degine, machi-bipidi dungumai, gangumai, degine, nue-binsaed-ibed-gumai-gusad. Ar Bab Dummad a-machi-bipigi nue nabir binsadii-gusad.
Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudigusad
Birga-irba Jesús-e-babgan Jerusalénse nad-damalad, Bab-Dummad-Israel-Dulemar-Egiptogi-Wilebukwa-Onosad-Ibagi.
Jesús birga-ambe-gakabo-nikadgi, e-babganba Jerusalénse nonimogad, ar igi gusgu na ibagi igar-maidba imakmaladba.
Ibagan bergusgu, Jesús-babgan gannar Nazaretse armargu, machigwa-Jesúsdi Jerusaléngi besad. José, degi, e-nan-María, amardi wichurmalad Jesús-besad.
E-babgandi dulemar-danar-danimaladba Jesús daniye bimalanad. Ibagwengus-nanaedgine e-gwenadgan-abargi, degine, mag-dakmalad-abargi Jesús-amiarmalad.
Ar amissurmarsoggu, gannar Jerusalénse Jesús-aminonimalad.
Degine, ibapaagwad-sorba amidapid, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, Moisés-igar-mesisad-nue-wisimalad-abargi sii, amar-itosii, degi, amarse ibmar egissii.
Ar bela-itobukmalad geger dakmalad Jesús nue ibmar wisi, degine, nue-imas Moisés-igar-nue-wisimalad abin-imaked.
E-babgan Jesús-dakarmargu, geger dakdemalad dummagan-abargi siid. E-nan Jesúsga sogded: —Machi, ¿ibiga we deyob be anmar-imaksa? Emide be-bab, degi, andi surbinsa anmar be-amidigu.
Geb degi Jesús abin-imakdegu, sogded: —¿Ar be wichurmarsi an-Bab-arbaedgi an arbaer-gebed?
Ar e-babgandi aku itosmalad ar ibi ega obarisa.
Jesús e-babganba arsunnad, gannar Nazaretse nonisunnad, na e-babgan-sogedba gudiguarsunnad. Ar e-nandi bela we-ibmarmar na e-gwageginbi sedii, egi binsadii-gualid.
Ar Jesúsdi ibmar-nue-wisidgi, e-dunguedgi, degine, Bab-Dummad-nue-nabir-egi-binsaedgi, degi, dulemar-nued-egi-binsaedgi dungumai-gusad.
